title: The Hedge distribution sums to one
statement:
Fix a number of experts $N \ge 1$, a horizon $T$, a learning rate $\eta \in \bbr$, a loss sequence $\ell$ for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds, and a round $t$. Then the Hedge distribution at round $t$ sums to one over all experts,
\[
  \sum_{i=1}^{N} p_t(i) = 1,
\]
so it is a probability distribution on the $N$ experts.
hypotheses_covered: at least one expert (N ≥ 1, from NeZero N)
arbitrary loss sequence ℓ for N experts over T rounds
replaced:
For any $\eta$, valid loss sequence $\ell$, and time $t$,
$\sum_{i=1}^{N} p_t(i) = 1$, so the Hedge distribution is a proper probability
distribution.
